# GeoCore — AI-Native Knowledge Operating System
> Build knowledge once. Validate strictly. Deliver everywhere without hallucinations.

GeoCore is an open-source, AI-native Knowledge Operating System (Knowledge OS) engineered for high-stakes domains (Healthcare, Clinical Dentistry, Agritech, Legal, B2B Compliance). It compiles structured Markdown knowledge objects into deterministic, mathematically grounded networks for websites, REST APIs, hybrid search engines (BM25 + Dense Vectors), and RAG AI assistants.

- Creator: Dr. Mossaab Rtimi (@mormox2)
- Professional Title: Chirurgien-Dentiste / Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) & Software Developer (Développeur de logiciels)
- Repository: https://github.com/mormox2/GeoCore
- Website: https://geocore.vercel.app/
- License: MIT
- Strict TypeScript: 100% type safety across 7 monorepo packages
- Test Coverage: 100% passing test suite

## Core Packages

- `@mormox2/geocore`: Core compiler, 10-stage validation pipeline, and schema generator.
- `@mormox2/geocore-cli`: Command-line tools (init, validate, export, inspect, serve, vectorize, studio).
- `@mormox2/geocore-server`: Standalone Node.js HTTP server with auto-generated OpenAPI & hybrid search endpoints.
- `@mormox2/geocore-db`: SQLite and DuckDB vector and relation database driver.
- `@mormox2/geocore-vector`: Pure TypeScript embedding computation, dense semantic search, and cosine ranking.
- `@mormox2/geocore-next`: Next.js 14+ App Router adapters, SEO metadata, JSON-LD Schema, and citations.
- `@mormox2/geocore-ai`: Deterministic grounding guardrails, anti-hallucination verification, and citation scoring.

## Key Capabilities

1. Deterministic Grounding Guardrails: Prevents hallucinations by calculating grounding confidence and verifying facts against certified evidence (PubMed, WHO, HAS, ISO).
2. Pure TypeScript Hybrid Search (RRF): Combines BM25 lexical precision with dense semantic vector embeddings.
3. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Generates compliant llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml, and Schema.org JSON-LD tags.
4. Interactive Visual Studio: In-browser 2D knowledge graph explorer, live editor, and RAG testing interface.
